home.title: Vietnam Powerlifting Federation
home.subtitle: The National Governing Body for Powerlifting in Vietnam
home.description: Vietnam Powerlifting Federation is the National Governing Body for the sport of Powerlifting in Vietnam. We are responsible for the development, promotion, and regulation of Powerlifting throughout Vietnam.

about.title: About Vietnam Powerlifting Federation
about.missionText: To promote and develop the sport of Powerlifting throughout Vietnam, ensuring fair competition and supporting athletes at all levels.
about.visionText: To be the leading Powerlifting organization in Vietnam, recognized for excellence, integrity, and athlete development.
about.integrityText: We maintain the highest standards of fairness and ethical conduct.
about.excellenceText: We strive for excellence in all aspects of our organization.
about.inclusivityText: We welcome athletes of all backgrounds and abilities.

meets.title: Meets
meets.subtitle: Create, edit and publish competitions.
meets.name: Meet name
meets.slugHint: Appears in the address bar. Changing it breaks existing links.
meets.openEndedStart: Leave empty to accept entries from today.
meets.openEndedClose: Leave empty to keep entries open indefinitely.
meets.systemYearHint: Decides which season a record counts towards. Defaults from the host date; a January meet may belong to the previous season.
meets.entryFeeHint: Set 0 for a free meet. Leaving it empty is also treated as free.
meets.spotterStub: The spotter button is shown to athletes but does not yet lead to a registration flow.
meets.legacyFlag: Legacy meet (best lifts only, no attempts)
meets.legacyLocked: Locked: this meet already has results, and the flag decides which table they live in.
meets.cloneHint: Copies the city, type, entry fee and registration rules. Dates, URL and system year start fresh, and the clone is created hidden.
meets.deleteWarning: Deleting cascades to results, the ban list and registrations. Hiding the meet is almost always the better choice.

banList.title: Not eligible to register
banList.subtitle: Athletes who cannot enter this meet — most often because they have already qualified, sometimes for discipline.
banList.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. đã giành HCV hạng cân 74 tại giải đấu X
banList.empty: Nobody is excluded from this meet.

import.title: Import results
import.subtitle: Results come in as a LiftingCast results CSV. Nothing is written until you confirm.
import.step1Hint: In LiftingCast: Results → Export → Awards results CSV.

matchedBy.name_birth_year: matched on name and birth year
matchedBy.name: name only — confirm

import.willDelete: These results are in the database but absent from the file, so they will be removed:
import.blocked: Fix the errors above before importing. Most are best fixed in LiftingCast and re-exported.
import.replaceWarning: Confirming replaces this meet's results with the file's contents, in one step. Re-importing a corrected file is safe.

entries.title: Entries
entries.subtitle: The start list that goes to LiftingCast, and comes back as results.
entries.readOnly: Results have been imported, so this roster is now a record of what was planned.

athletes.title: Athletes
athletes.subtitle: Every account, including lapsed members.
athletes.search: Search name, VPF ID, email or national ID
athletes.identityHint: These fields came from the athlete's approved CCCD submission. Correcting a typo here does not change their verified status.
athletes.emailChangeHint: Changing the email will mark it unverified until the athlete confirms the new address.
athletes.slugChangeHint: Existing links to this profile will stop working.
athletes.vipNullHint: Clearing this revokes VIP. For permanent VIP, set a far-future date.
athletes.rackHint: Athletes set these themselves; staff correct them at weigh-in. Only the squat and bench rack heights reach LiftingCast — the other two are sent as a note.
athletes.dopingWarning: A doping ban blocks this athlete from registering for any meet. Say why — it is recorded against your account.
athletes.notesHint: Only visible to staff. Never shown to the athlete.

purchases.title: Purchases
purchases.subtitle: Match bank transfers to registrations and memberships.
purchases.search: Search ref code, name or email

violations.title: Violations
violations.subtitle: An athlete's level is how many of their violations are still in force. Level 1 means a pledge and a fine; level 2 blocks them from competing.
violations.expireYearHint: The last season this counts against the athlete. Clearing it makes the sanction permanent.
violations.confirmPermanent: Yes, this violation should never expire

outcomes.pledge: Must sign a pledge and pay a fine before competing

violations.liftPrompt: The violation is removed and stops counting towards the athlete's level. Say why — it is recorded against your account.
violations.impactBlocked: This moves the athlete to level {level} and blocks them from every meet through {year}.
violations.impactPledge: This moves the athlete to level 1: they may still compete, but must sign a pledge and pay a fine.
violations.outcomePledge: Level 1 — may compete after a pledge and a fine.
